thesis: The episode explores the parallels between neurosurgery and capital allocation by examining the high-stakes decision-making process involved in conducting brain surgery. The discussion highlights how a neurosurgeon begins by understanding the patient's context and history before utilizing complex imaging to assess risk and uncertainty.
